purpose: Adopt open-source capabilities only when they improve Dealix revenue, trust, reliability, research or delivery without creating a parallel Company Machine.
rules: One-Company Law: no duplicate CRM, analytics plane, scheduler, approval authority or Company Brain
Default new server services to loopback/private networking
Public exposure, secrets, DNS, production DB and paid services remain separately gated
Scraping/research must respect robots.txt, site terms, privacy and evidence provenance

adopt_next_private.name: louislam/uptime-kuma
adopt_next_private.role: independent HTTP/TCP/DNS/TLS uptime and certificate monitoring
adopt_next_private.deployment: VPS loopback/private only; uptime never equals Production Green

adopt_next_private.name: dgtlmoon/changedetection.io
adopt_next_private.deployment: VPS loopback/private; webhook events feed Market Signal receipts

adopt_next_private.name: unclecode/crawl4ai
adopt_next_private.role: LLM-ready web extraction for bounded market intelligence
adopt_next_private.deployment: private Docker/API; exact version pin; domain allowlist; respect robots/terms

adopt_next_private.name: open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib
adopt_next_private.deployment: phase-in behind current observability; do not replace proven telemetry blindly

evaluate_later.name: searxng/searxng
evaluate_later.reason: useful private metasearch but adds maintenance and provider-policy complexity

evaluate_later.name: DIYgod/RSSHub
evaluate_later.reason: useful feed normalization but broad route surface and source-terms burden

evaluate_later.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
evaluate_later.reason: powerful self-hosted extraction, but overlaps Crawl4AI and should not duplicate crawler planes

do_not_add_now.name: self-hosted Sentry
do_not_add_now.reason: existing SDK is sufficient now; self-hosted server is FSL and operationally heavy
